# This is Suricata version 8.0.8 RELEASE, run by make-smtp-verdicts.py; do not edit by hand.
# 'rule SID RULE', or 'refused SID RULE' when Suricata does not load it,
# then 'packet NS HEX SIDS': the packet's time in nanoseconds, its IP
# bytes and the sids that alerted on it, a sid once per alert, '-' for none,
# then 'end N SIDS': what alerted when flow N was flushed at the end of
# the capture, its last address byte being N, then 'proto N NAME': the
# application protocol Suricata logged for flow N.
rule 15000 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15000"; file.data; content:"ustar";)
rule 15001 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15001"; file.data; content:"070707"; startswith;)
rule 15002 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15002"; file.data; content:"Hello body";)
rule 15003 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15003"; file.data; content:"quoted=printable";)
rule 15004 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15004"; file.data; content:"quoted printable joined";)
rule 15005 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15005"; file.data; content:"plain attachment";)
rule 15006 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15006"; file.data; content:"AAAA";)
rule 15007 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15007"; file.data; content:"nested part";)
rule 15008 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15008"; file.data; content:"named by type";)
rule 15009 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15009"; file.data; content:"no mime";)
rule 15010 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15010"; file.data; content:"dot.stuffed";)
rule 15011 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15011"; file.data; content:"..stuffed";)
rule 15012 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15012"; flow:established,to_server; file.data; content:"split across";)
rule 15013 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15013"; file.data; content:"ustar";)
rule 15014 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15014"; file.data; content:"inline part";)
rule 15015 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15015"; file.data; content:"|0d 0a|second line";)
rule 15016 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15016"; file.data; content:"Content-Type";)
rule 15017 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15017"; file.data; content:"ustar"; isdataat:!1,relative;)
rule 15018 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15018"; file.data; content:"trailing"; isdataat:!1,relative;)
rule 15019 alert smtp any any -> any any (msg:"smtp 15019"; file.data; content:"plain attachment"; startswith;)
